title: Signature Stress Forge — Prime corner
description: The prime corner runs genuine Lucas-Lehmer tests on small exponents as a correctness ritual before every stress run. If the machine cannot prove 524287 prime, it has no business being called stable.

title: Signature Stress Forge — Safety brain
description: The safety brain enforces temperature ceilings per component and halts the trial the instant one is crossed, logging the exact second. It also refuses to start if baseline idle temps already look wrong.
